description: Dependency policy for every repo of the family (root + the four service repos), applied by the self-hosted bot as the defaults for each repo (scripts/renovate-run.sh merges it into the global config). One run = one PR per repo: every update, majors and security fixes included, lands in a single 'all dependencies' PR that each run refreshes. The CI job's 24h last-checked stamp is the only throttle; there is no Renovate schedule. Repo renovate.json files only add repo-specific rules.

packageRules.description: Docker Hub often returns no publish timestamps; without this, minimumReleaseAge would hold those images back indefinitely.
One PR per repo per run: every update joins the 'all dependencies' group (renovate/all branch).
Label PRs that carry a major update; the (future) LLM fix-up pipeline keys on it.
The Bisq daemons are built against JDK 21; a JDK major is a Bisq-upstream decision, not ours.
Stateful / money-handling software (data migrations, wallet formats): kept out of the all-dependencies PR and only proposed, as its own PR, once approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
